test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**described**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence refers to how Ms Navalnaya is publicly recognized or referred to as the 'First Lady' of the Russian opposition.
 
• The verb "**described**" fits best here as it means someone is characterized or portrayed in a certain way.
